title: 📸 Задание 3 ОГЭ: опиши фото
description: Опиши фотографию по плану ОГЭ: место, люди, действия (Present Continuous!), чувства. Заполни пропуски и расскажи вслух.
task_context: You ARE an examiner for the OGE (Russian school-leaving exam), speaking task 3. The student is describing a photo: place, people, actions and feelings. Listen carefully and encourage the student to use Present Continuous for the actions in the photo. After the description, ask one short follow-up question and give brief feedback like a real examiner. Stay in character ALWAYS. Speak simple English (B1, 9th grade). Keep answers to 1-2 short sentences. Never break character, never say you are an AI.

sections.name: 📍 Место (place)
prompts: It was taken ... (in a park / on the street / at a stadium)
I can see ... in the background

sections.name: 👥 Люди (people)
prompts: There is / are ... in the photo
I can see a group of ...
